notes: First daf of the post-PR#148 remediation campaign. Fresh reconstruction of all 66 raw Rashi lines against the 17-id local segment table (l01, l06, l12, l13, l16, l21, l25, l27, l33, l36, l39, l41, l42, l44a, l44b, l46, l47), covering the mishmar-hamenora dispute over whether 'me'erev ad boker' bounds only the lamp-lighting or forbids any other service through the night, Rav Pappa's harmonization of the mishna (incense-then-lamps, Rabbanan) against the payis mishna (lamps-then-incense, Abba Shaul) by splitting the seder-yoma mishna's reisha/seifa (Rabbanan) from its metzia (Abba Shaul), Abaye's rejection of that split via the two-lamps-then-five-lamps ordering across chapters, his alternative that the first chapter's seven-day repetition is mere training and not sequence-bound, the derivation from 'u'se'ir izim echad lechatat Hashem al olat hatamid' that the tamid's blood placement is split like a chatat's despite remaining an olah, the arba-shehen-arba/lo-matzinu-damim-she'mechaprin kal vachomer challenging why the tamid's placement is not fully quartered, and the goat-blood-of-Yom-Kippur-sprinkling passage (achat lemala ve'sheva lematah, ke'matzlif, tihara) closing the amud with the 'agufeih' catchword continuing onto 15b. Prior content was 100% meta-narration ('Rashi: opens/continues/concludes...'): all 65 of 66 lines baselined scaffold-prefix (line 66, the single-word catchword line, was the only one not separately baselined, though its prior content was equally scaffold-style); prior links were positional (monotonic walk through the 17 ids in order, skipping l27 and l46 - never verified against actual dibbur-hamatchil text).
